Name: Automate Pro
Author: palmhacker13
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#fa8c16]Automate Pro[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Event-driven, zero-allocation automation engineered for massive Stardew Valley 1.6+ factories[/i][/size]

[b][color=#52c41a]Zero-Polling Engine[/color]  •  [color=#1890ff]Mega-Factory Ready[/color]  •  [color=#eb2f96]Interactive Visual Overlay[/color][/b]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]⚡ Built for Massive Factories & Smooth Frame Rates[/b][/size]

[b]Automate Pro[/b] is an event-driven automation engine designed from the ground up for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]. Whether you run a cozy greenhouse or an industrial-scale farm with thousands of machines, Automate Pro keeps your frame times flat and responsive.

[list]
[*][b]Event-Driven, Zero-Polling Architecture:[/b] Powered by machine-ready Harmony hooks, inventory change events, and unified sub-minute scheduling—idle machines are skipped instantly instead of scanning your entire farm every tick.[/*]
[*][b]Zero-Allocation Hot Paths:[/b] Routing, batched topology updates, and overlay rendering are engineered to minimize garbage collection (GC) overhead and prevent micro-stutters.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Machine Scheduling:[/b] Adding, triggering, or removing machines updates in O(1) without scanning active machine lists.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Unique Features & Smart Routing[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Interactive Visual Overlay (Press [font=Courier New]U[/font]):[/b] See your entire automation network at a glance with color-coded group borders, smooth animated flow chevrons, directional item-flow particles, Bottleneck Heatmap mode ([font=Courier New]Shift+U[/font]), and hover inspection cards.[/*]
[*][b]Factory Control Tablet (Press [font=Courier New]F7[/font]):[/b] Manage every automated network remotely—inspect live production, edit chest tags, sort/deposit via Stock Hub, review 7-day profit history, and enforce Host-authoritative Co-op permissions & Audit Logs.[/*]
[*][b]Quick Chest I/O Mode Switching:[/b] While the Overlay is open, [b]Right-Click[/b] any Chest, Big Chest, Junimo Chest, Fridge, or Auto-Grabber to instantly cycle modes without opening menus:
  [color=#1890ff][b]Normal [I/O][/b][/color] ➔ [color=#52c41a][b]Input Only [IN][/b][/color] ➔ [color=#fa8c16][b]Output Only [OUT][/b][/color] ➔ [color=#8c8c8c][b]Ignored [OFF][/b][/color][/*]
[*][b]Cross-Location Relays & Tags:[/b] Link storage and machines across different maps using [font=Courier New]#global[/font] and [font=Courier New]#ch:X[/font] channel tags (with optional priority tiers, [font=Courier New]#min:N[/font] buffers, and [font=Courier New]#max:N[/font] output quotas).[/*]
[*][b]Smart Production Controls:[/b] Per-machine priority preferences, buffer limits, overflow shipping policies, [b]Profit Maximizer[/b], [b]Fleet Resync[/b], and optional [b]Swarm Co-Processing[/b] (with realistic diminishing-returns multi-machine scaling).[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🏭 Broad Machine & Storage Support[/b][/size]

Works seamlessly with [b]Chests, Big Chests, Junimo Chests, FarmHouse/Island Fridges, Shipping Bins, Mini-Shipping Bins, Auto-Grabbers[/b], and machines including:
[list]
[*]Kegs, Preserves Jars, Casks, Furnaces, Crystalariums, Oil Makers, Cheese/Mayo Machines, Looms, Dehydrators, Bait Makers, Fish Smokers[/*]
[*]Crab Pots, Incubators, Geode Crushers, Deconstructors, Slime Troughs, Statues[/*]
[*]Fruit Trees, Berry Bushes, Tappers, Tree Moss, and Flooring/Path Connectors[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🔗 Ecosystem Integrations & Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Official Companion Add-on — Automate Pro - Overclock:[/b] Optional add-on that adds tiered Overclock Core machines (Mk.I–Mk.IV), EU fuel grids, consumable Gem Chips, Thermal Cooling, Overclock Network Auras in the [font=Courier New]U[/font] Overlay, and a remote [b]Overclock[/b] button inside the Factory Tablet.[/*]
[*]Native support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55495][b]Next-Gen Auto-Grabber[/b][/url] ([font=Courier New]IAutomateProApi[/font]), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50971][b]UltraSmooth[/b][/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url].[/*]
[*][b]Legacy Automate API Bridge ([font=Courier New]Pathoschild.Automate[/font]):[/b] Includes an optional compatibility bridge for third-party mods that use SMAPI's standard dynamic API lookup ([font=Courier New]helper.ModRegistry.GetApi("Pathoschild.Automate")[/font]).[/*]
[*][b][color=#fa8c16]Compatibility Note:[/color][/b] Automate Pro intentionally does [b]not[/b] ship a spoofed [font=Courier New]Automate.dll[/font] assembly. Mods that hard-reference [font=Courier New]Automate.dll[/font] directly at compile time (rather than using SMAPI's dynamic [font=Courier New]GetApi[/font] interface) cannot be satisfied by Automate Pro and must be updated by their authors to use a dynamic API proxy.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center]
[size=5][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/size]
[b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]  •  [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]
